Package hadur2.core.role

Interface Role

All Known Implementing Classes:
DuelSeam, MeleeSeam
public interface Role
The strand contract (A2): every strand's brain sits behind one of these, and the conductor runs the same steps whichever role drives. A brain never implements it itself; the conductor's seam for that brain does, turning each Tick into the brain's own arguments, so dependencies run one way, from conductor to brain.

Per tick: the conductor offers each event to the roles of the charter, Melee before Duel, in the engine's order (observe(hadur2.core.model.BotEvent, hadur2.core.role.Tick), ROLE-5); then the driving role alone fills the orders (drive(hadur2.core.role.Tick, hadur2.core.model.BotOrders.Builder), WEAVE-1). observe gets no orders to write: only the driving role originates a tick's orders.
